params.name: n_element_types
params.doc: Distinct element types in circulation. Must exceed the union of all big-thing requirements so competition is real.

params.name: n_big_things
params.doc: Number of big things (alpha, beta, ...). 2 creates competition.

params.name: requirement_size
params.doc: Size of each big thing's defining element set R.

params.name: sufficiency_k
params.doc: Any k-of-R held elements suffice to become a latent adopter (set-sufficiency encoding). k==R means strict all-of.

params.name: element_overlap
params.doc: How many element types two adjacent big things share. >0 makes big things compete for the same elements.

params.name: requirement_encoding
params.doc: How elements compose into a big thing. set_sufficiency favored; ordering is an equivalent combinatoric encoding; additive disfavored.

params.name: transmissibility_mode
params.doc: THE WEDGE. elements_only = our model (big things never transmit whole). whole_package = recovers SIR / complex contagion in-model. both = whole only between compression-equipped agents.

params.name: n_agents
params.doc: Population size. 100 keeps iteration fast as mechanisms stack.

params.name: topology
params.doc: Network structure. small_world is the lead; uniform_mixing only for SIR-family legibility.

params.name: mean_degree
params.doc: Target average number of ties per agent (density driver).

params.name: rewire_prob
params.doc: Watts-Strogatz rewiring probability (small_world only).

params.name: capacity
params.doc: Max element-slots an agent can hold. The threshold/capacity ratio is the competition engine.

params.name: eviction_rule
params.doc: Who gets dropped when capacity binds. value_weighted (keep elements feeding a near-complete big thing) is the substantively richest.

params.name: transmission_prob
params.doc: Probability a held element transmits on a given contact. Low values lengthen the latent build phase where the interesting inertia lives.

params.name: loss_rate
params.doc: Spontaneous per-tick element forgetting. Off by default so V1 dynamics are not confounded.

params.name: contacts_per_tick
params.doc: Contacts each active agent makes per tick. Sets the clock.

params.name: scheduling
params.doc: asynchronous avoids lockstep-flip artifacts; synchronous updates all agents at once.

params.name: run_length
params.doc: Max ticks. Runs also stop early on quiescence.

params.name: quiescence_window
params.doc: Stop early if no element movement for this many ticks (0 disables).

params.name: differential_slot_cost
params.doc: Big ideas occupy 2 slots, elements 1.

params.name: compression
params.doc: On activation, constituent elements collapse into a chunk at smaller footprint; frees capacity but can no longer be transmitted as pieces.

params.name: stabilization
params.doc: On activation, constituent elements become harder to dislodge.

params.name: enhanced_transmission
params.doc: On activation, constituent elements become more transmissible to neighbors (the invisible becomes visible).

params.name: stabilization_boost
params.doc: Multiplier reducing loss/eviction pressure on stabilized elements (0 = immovable, 1 = no effect).

params.name: enhanced_factor
params.doc: Multiplier on transmission_prob for elements of an active big thing.

params.name: tie_strength_channels
params.doc: 90/10 weak/strong tie structure; per-interaction transmission scales with tie strength.

params.name: strong_tie_fraction
params.doc: Fraction of an agent's ties that are strong (tie_strength_channels).

params.name: internal_coupling
params.doc: EXTENSION. Signed coupling: a held big thing biases adoption / element-retention of OTHER big things (off-diagonal).

params.name: neighbor_coupling
params.doc: EXTENSION. Same signed structure sourced externally: a neighbor's big thing biases your adoption of others. Subsumes complex contagion as the positive same-target cell.

params.name: coupling_level
params.doc: Does coupling act at the big-thing level or per element.

params.name: coupling_strength
params.doc: Signed coupling multiplier. Negative = antagonism, positive = facilitation. 0 = off even if a coupling switch is on.

params.name: seeding_scheme
params.doc: Where elements start. clustered manufactures at-risk / resistant groups on purpose.

params.name: initial_element_density
params.doc: Fraction of (agent, element-type) cells seeded at t=0.

params.name: change_agent_scenario
params.doc: Inject a fully-equipped, manifest minority into an unprepared population (produces the failed-diffusion signature).

params.name: change_agent_fraction
params.doc: Share of population seeded fully equipped and manifest.

params.name: change_agent_clustered
params.doc: Place change agents in a cluster (vs dispersed).

params.name: change_agent_evangelism
params.doc: Multiplier on change agents' transmission probability (1.0 = baseline, like everyone else).

params.name: trigger_type
params.doc: exogenous = global shock at a set time (mass-media exemplar). endogenous = fires when enough neighbors are latent/manifest (focal-point / emergent-need).

params.name: trigger_time
params.doc: Tick at which the exogenous trigger fires (and recurs every trigger_time ticks).

params.name: endogenous_trigger_threshold
params.doc: Fraction of neighbors latent/manifest required to fire manifestation (endogenous only).

params.name: trigger_reach
params.doc: Fraction of latent adopters actually flipped when the trigger fires.

params.name: seed
params.doc: Random seed. Fixed seed => fully reproducible run.

params.name: replications
params.doc: Replications per parameter cell in a sweep (stochastic averaging). Ignored by single live runs.

phase_defs.title: V0 — unrestricted baseline
phase_defs.desc: Elements diffuse, big things activate on composition, unlimited capacity. Should saturate. Confirms the machinery.
phase_defs.predict: Everyone acquires everything; all big things activate.
